column1: # Exact finding-count ratchet for Kubernetes manifests extracted from KRO RGDs.
# Columns: count, repository-relative RGD path, Trivy check ID, severity, extracted line range.
# This is not an ignore file: scan-rgd-templates.sh runs every Trivy misconfiguration check without
# exclusions, then fails on any difference from these visible findings. A finding removed from the
# templates must be removed here in the same change; a new finding must be fixed, not baselined.
# Measured with Trivy v0.74.0 and the policies embedded in that binary. Pull-request CI pins the
# binary; scan-rgd-templates.sh rejects any other version and disables independent policy updates.
